name: Noumi Mizuha
source:
"Me too, kind of, I'm everyone's childhood friend......"

Likes: [url=/c125620]Shinra[/url]'s scent

A member of the "Childhood Friend Corps". However, since she does not want to stand out like the others, she becomes a rather plain girl who has not been recognized by her surroundings. She is a member of the library committee and is always at the library counter after school.

Shy, reserved, and timid, she does her best to keep up with her assertive childhood friends, but is often gets swayed.

She has a strong odor fetish and likes the smells of the library and Shinra's. In particular, because of the protagonist's scent, she seems to have special feelings for him......

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/mizuha.html]official website[/url]]
